scope: Narrow evidence identity fix, regression and one-time m315 recovery guards; final tranche release requires separate verification.

findings.subject: Evidence admission identity
findings.reason: Source + resolved GradeID + Locator + Topic + literal Finding preserves independent same-heading bullets and product scopes; an exact repeat writes nothing.

findings.subject: Meaningful disposable regression
findings.reason: Two different clauses under one heading and one same-wording clause on another product survive as exactly three rows; repeated identical clause and repeated batch add no rows or changes. Independently ran both focused tests; 2/2 pass.

findings.subject: m315 one-time recovery
findings.reason: Full pre-repair data-manifest SHA binds the original baseline; only frozen operation IDs e2/e3/e4 allow zero matches under explicit flag. Uses operation id. All other source, grade and already admitted rows require exact ownership and one complete agreeing row. Ordinary rerun is strict; modified statement cannot silently append under recovery after manifest changes.

findings.subject: Measurement Notes guard
findings.reason: Exact comparison includes the deterministic Added date/migration/page note that writeBatch actually prepends; all other measurement fields remain guarded.

limitations: No independent full-release QA is inferred from this targeted code review.
The repair flag is one-time; after successful repair, regular strict rerun is the idempotence check.
No source quote, numeric value, selection engine or schema is changed by writer fix.
